fixes.fix: Introduced one authoritative resolver _closed_loop_database_url(chain_id, network). An explicitly pinned _native_database_url on the instance wins. Otherwise the consumer resolver is authoritative and a None answer means the scope has no database (no fallback to another chain's store). When the chain-scoped path for the chain actually being processed differs from the resolved target, the chain-scoped path wins, so a testnet scan can never write into the mainnet store.
fixes.rootCause: mark_group_submitted and claim_review_before_submit resolved the closed-loop target through closed_loop_consumer.resolve_runtime_database, while complete_loop and scope_error_isolation_active used the mixin's own _native_database_url(chain_id) derived from the chain runtime registry. When the two resolvers disagreed, the claim was written into one SQLite file and the completion into another, so the loop was stranded in preflight_running forever and never reached preflight_failed.
fixes.title: closed-loop database resolver split caused permanent preflight_running stall

fixes.fix: Added an autouse fixture that intercepts execute/executemany/replace_rows/transaction/delete_rows on core.db.storage_business_io and raises AssertionError when the resolved target parent is the real chain database directory. The guard is additionally applied to dex.runtime.closed_loop_state_machine and dex.runtime.closed_loop_consumer so module-level name bindings cannot bypass it.
fixes.rootCause: core.db.storage_business_io write entry points were not intercepted, so a test that resolved a chain database through the runtime registry wrote fixture rows into flashloan/db/local_store_4663.sqlite3 (mainnet) and local_store_46630.sqlite3 (testnet). Modules that bind 'from ... import execute' at module level also bypassed patching of the storage_business_io module attributes alone.
fixes.title: test suite could write fixture rows into real production chain databases

fixes.fix: Session-scoped working-directory sandbox, per-test reset of the dynamic RPC offline reason set, per-test removal of FLASHLOAN_KV_PATH from os.environ, and per-test reset of the chain runtime registry.
fixes.rootCause: flashloan/app_runtime/.env line 615 hardcodes FLASHLOAN_KV_PATH to the mainnet database and load_env_files writes it into os.environ, which polluted the whole suite. In addition the global chain runtime registry, the dynamic RPC offline reason set, and the process working directory leaked between tests.
fixes.title: test environment pollution from production .env and global runtime registries

fixes.fix: Deleted the three fixture rows together with the matching v4_closed_loop_error_isolation rows. Both databases were re-verified read-only after the cleanup and again after the full round-21 gate run: zero fixture rows remain.
fixes.rootCause: Fixture rows written by earlier test runs remained in the two real chain databases: two rows in the mainnet store (token pair 0x1111...:0x2222...:0x3333... in preflight_running and 0x1111...:0x3333...:0x2222... in preflight_failed) and one row in the testnet store (0x1111...:0x2222...:0x3333... in execution_success with tx_hash 0xabc123).
fixes.title: production database fixture pollution cleanup
